task: Implement canonical executable cross-template distinctness / anti-clone intelligence over the source-controlled storefront template catalog, using explainable multi-axis package similarity plus Template Genome exclusion semantics, without introducing a subjective visual ranking or a parallel template authority.

operationalIntelligence.problemStatement: Visual DNA and Genome exclusion conventions already describe intended separation, and the repository has a canonical source-controlled catalog of real installable template packages, but no executable multi-axis similarity budget automatically detects repaint clones, repeated section rhythm, copied shape/media language or interaction/composition reuse before a new template enters production.
observableOutcomes: A deterministic distinctness profiler derives comparable signatures from candidate and reference installable packages without screenshots, embeddings or subjective model judgment.
The profiler evaluates composition, section rhythm, typography, spacing, density, shape, media language and interaction as separate explainable axes.
Candidate packages are automatically compared against every other source-controlled STOREFRONT_IMPLEMENTED_TEMPLATE_PACKAGES entry; same templateKey history is excluded.
A weighted overall similarity budget and critical-axis cluster budget fail closed on clone-like convergence while tolerating shared runtime/component grammar.
Template Genome exclusion identities/similarities are bound as hard semantic guardrails against named references such as Playroom.
Generator Readiness consumes distinctness validity for real Factory builds without changing Page Schema or Runtime truth.
Result evidence identifies the nearest references and the exact axes that exceed budget so later bounded repair can act on ordinary Builder/Factory inputs.
No external screenshot scorer, AI embedding, popularity score or subjective best/worst ranking becomes production authority.
unresolvedRisks: Shared component registry naturally creates structural overlap and must not itself be classified as cloning.
Text-copy tokens could overfit language/brand names instead of visual grammar.
A simple average can hide three critically cloned axes behind unrelated low-similarity axes.
Package-only legacy references lack Brabus Genome semantics, so candidate Genome exclusions must complement rather than replace objective package profiling.
Importing the global catalog must not create a Factory/catalog circular dependency.
Similarity thresholds chosen without adversarial clone/near-clone fixtures could be arbitrary.

in: Canonical deterministic eight-axis package distinctness profile.
Catalog-wide candidate versus all-other-template comparison using STOREFRONT_IMPLEMENTED_TEMPLATE_PACKAGES.
Weighted overall budget plus critical-axis cluster rule.
Explainable nearest-reference evidence and bounded repair hints.
Maturity promotion with adversarial exact-clone, repaint-clone, partial-clone and legitimate-shared-grammar proof.
out: AI embeddings or subjective aesthetic scoring.
VX Smart Intent or Smart Auto-Fix.
New Control Plane gate or separate visual acceptance authority.

assuranceCeiling.rationale: Anti-clone becomes a mandatory precondition for new template production. Highest practical assurance is deterministic package-derived profiling across the full real catalog, independent axis evidence, adversarial clone fixtures, explicit thresholds and Genome exclusion semantics while keeping Product Owner visual approval as a separate authority.

acceptanceCriteria: One versioned distinctness contract profiles exactly eight mandatory axes: composition, sectionRhythm, typography, spacing, density, shape, mediaLanguage and interaction.
All axis values are derived from canonical package structure/configuration; concrete media source paths are never used as similarity evidence.
Candidate compares against every other real implemented catalog package, excluding same templateKey history.
Each comparison reports per-axis similarity, weighted overall similarity, critical-axis exceedances and pass/block reason.
Exact clone and style-only/repaint clone adversarial fixtures block.
Legitimate templates sharing the same Page Schema/component registry do not block solely because of shared primitives.
Genome exclusions can target a reference identity and tighten the relevant axis budget; UNKNOWN exclusion targets do not silently pass.
Generator Readiness is false when distinctness blocks in canonical Factory context.
FACTORY-DISTINCTNESS-ANTI-CLONE becomes PROVEN only after executable implementation/tests.

FACTORY-DYNAMIC-PRODUCTION-COMPILER remains EVOLVE and must still appear in blockingCapabilityIds after anti-clone promotion, proving distinctness completion cannot unlock Template #3 or dynamic compilation by itself.
invariants: Shared Page Schema/component vocabulary is not itself clone evidence.
Same templateKey versions are lineage/evolution and are excluded from cross-template clone comparison.
Similarity evidence excludes timestamps, CI IDs and concrete media file paths.
Product Owner approval remains visual authority; distinctness only enforces anti-clone constraints.
UNKNOWN/empty corpus for a generator-ready Factory candidate never counts as distinctness PASS.
Distinctness result never mutates candidate/reference packages.

failureModes: Exact clone receives PASS because only color/media source paths differ.
A repaint clone hides high composition/rhythm/shape similarity behind low copy-token similarity.
Shared header/footer/component primitives make unrelated templates falsely block.
Candidate compares against its own previous version and is incorrectly classified as a clone.
Genome says avoid Playroom rhythm but high Playroom rhythm similarity does not tighten the verdict.
Catalog is empty or filtered to zero references and distinctness returns PASS.
edgeCases: Reference package lacks Brabus Genome but remains comparable through package-derived profile.
Candidate introduces a new component unknown to older templates; unknown tokens increase distinctness but do not erase cloned critical axes.
Two templates share typography but differ strongly in composition/media/interaction and should remain allowed.
A clone changes brand copy, colors and image filenames only; path/copy noise must not rescue it.
A candidate in a one-template repository still fails corpus completeness rather than fabricating reference evidence.

alternatives.summary: Derive deterministic package signatures and compare against the canonical implemented-template catalog.
alternatives.reason: Works for both legacy and Brabus templates without inventing retrospective Genomes or relying on screenshots/AI.
Most existing catalog templates do not yet have canonical Genomes, so Template #3 could clone legacy packages undetected.

alternatives.summary: Use image/embedding similarity over browser screenshots.
alternatives.reason: Would introduce a new probabilistic visual authority and operational complexity before deterministic structural/style evidence is exhausted.

specialistReviews.finding: STOREFRONT_IMPLEMENTED_TEMPLATE_PACKAGES is the existing real package corpus; distinctness should consume it rather than maintain a duplicate reference registry.
specialistReviews.resolution: Import catalog read-only, exclude same templateKey, and keep the profiler inside builder-template-system.

specialistReviews.finding: A single similarity average can hide clone-like convergence on composition/rhythm/shape.
specialistReviews.resolution: Use independent axis scores plus a critical-axis cluster blocker in addition to weighted overall similarity.

specialistReviews.finding: Shared components and checkout/account shells are expected across templates and must not create false clone verdicts.
specialistReviews.resolution: Profile normalized visual grammar/configuration and home/body rhythm while down-weighting shared shell primitives.

specialistReviews.finding: Distinctness cannot mutate package/runtime truth or use concrete media paths as evidence.
specialistReviews.resolution: Pure profiler/evaluator returns immutable evidence and repair hints only; Runtime/Page Schema remain untouched.

challenge.scenario: Candidate package is byte-semantic clone of Playroom with only templateKey/version changed.
challenge.finding: Exact structural/style clone must block independent of identity.
challenge.resolution: Package-derived eight-axis profile produces high overall and critical-axis similarity; comparison blocks.

challenge.scenario: Candidate clones Playroom layout/spacing/shape but changes colors, brand copy and image filenames.
challenge.finding: A repaint clone must not escape via non-visual token noise.
challenge.resolution: Exclude concrete media paths and generic copy from core axes; critical composition/rhythm/spacing/shape cluster blocks.

challenge.scenario: Candidate and reference both use system.commerce-header, layout.section and commerce.product-grid.
challenge.finding: Shared canonical primitives are legitimate reuse.
challenge.resolution: Common primitive keys are normalized/down-weighted; similarity depends on sequence/configuration/style grammar rather than mere component presence.

challenge.scenario: Loot Vault v2 is compared to legacy Loot Vault v1.
challenge.finding: Evolution of the same template identity must not be classified as cross-template cloning.
challenge.resolution: Exclude all references with candidate templateKey regardless of version.

challenge.scenario: Genome exclusion names Playroom rhythm/media language while corresponding package axes exceed normal warning budget.
challenge.finding: Declared semantic exclusion should tighten rather than merely annotate evidence.
challenge.resolution: Reference-targeted Genome exclusions create a hard violation when targeted critical axes exceed exclusion threshold.

challenge.scenario: Candidate shares typography with a reference but composition, rhythm, shape, media and interaction are distinct.
challenge.finding: Single-axis similarity is not enough to call a clone.
challenge.resolution: Block requires overall budget or multi-critical-axis cluster, not one ordinary high axis.

challenge.scenario: Implemented-template catalog yields zero non-self references.
challenge.finding: No evidence exists to prove cross-template distinctness.

challenge.scenario: Candidate changes nested style object key insertion order only.
challenge.finding: Equivalent package should not produce different profile or verdict.
challenge.resolution: Profile collection and token sets are canonical-order/unique-sorted before scoring.

proofPlan: Exact-clone adversarial proof blocks a candidate cloned from a foreign catalog package.
Repaint-clone proof changes identity/color/copy/media paths but preserves visual grammar and still blocks.
Single-axis-overlap proof remains allowed when critical-axis cluster and overall budget stay below threshold.
Same-templateKey historical version exclusion proof prevents self-lineage false positives.
Catalog-wide canonical Loot Vault v2 proof remains distinct from every other implemented template, including Playroom.
Genome exclusion proof tightens Playroom-targeted rhythm/media rules.
Generator Readiness combination proof fails closed on blocking distinctness and exposes nearest references/axes.
Maturity proof promotes only anti-clone while Dynamic Production Compiler remains EVOLVE.
Normal CI + exact-head Template Factory Quality Gate v2 + Completion Truth + lifecycle closure.

requirements.requirement: Canonical deterministic anti-clone engine compares each candidate against every other real implemented template across eight explainable visual-grammar axes with explicit budgets.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: Anti-clone uses deterministic package evidence and Genome exclusions, not subjective/AI visual ranking.

requirements.requirement: Exact/repaint/multi-critical-axis clones and empty reference corpora cannot produce distinctness PASS or generator-ready Factory status.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: Clone-like convergence cannot be hidden by color/copy/path-only changes.

requirements.requirement: Anti-clone completion does not promote the Dynamic Production Compiler or VX Smart systems.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: Distinctness completion cannot imply dynamic compilation or Smart Intent/Auto-Fix is proven.

notes: Sixth Brabus hardening wave. Genome, Type System, Constraint Planner, Media Planner and deterministic lineage are PROVEN and lifecycle-closed. This wave turns existing Visual DNA/exclusion conventions into executable catalog-wide anti-clone evidence. Template #3 remains forbidden. Canonical anti-clone projection reconciled: release-infrastructure is outside scope; SQ-NK-005 does not apply; guard digest 1c170eef; downstream capability-separation acceptance is now explicitly falsifiable.
